developer_onboarding.subject: Welcome to QuantCAI ⚛️ — Build Your First Quantum Circuit
developer_onboarding.headline: Start Simulating Quantum Circuits
developer_onboarding.body_html:
Welcome to QuantCAI! We're thrilled to have you join our community of quantum developers.

As your first step, we recommend trying out our interactive circuit builder. You can start with a simple Bell State or dive into Grover's algorithm.

developer_onboarding.subject: Export your quantum circuits to Qiskit 🐍
developer_onboarding.headline: From Browser to IBM Quantum
developer_onboarding.body_html:
Did you know you can export any circuit built in QuantCAI directly to Qiskit Python code?

This means you can prototype in our visual editor, export the code, and run it on real quantum hardware via IBM Quantum.

developer_onboarding.subject: Quantum-Safe Cryptography: Is your code ready? 🛡️
developer_onboarding.headline: The Post-Quantum Threat
developer_onboarding.body_html:
As quantum hardware scales, classical encryption like RSA and ECC becomes vulnerable.

Explore our Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) scanner to identify weak algorithms in your GitHub repositories and get migration recommendations for ML-KEM and ML-DSA.

ciso_nurture.subject: Your QuantCAI PQC Audit Report is Ready 📊
ciso_nurture.headline: Cryptographic Vulnerability Audit
ciso_nurture.body_html:
Thank you for using QuantCAI's PQC Scanner. Your preliminary audit report highlights several repositories using legacy algorithms (RSA, ECC) that are vulnerable to 'Harvest Now, Decrypt Later' attacks.

The NSA CNSA 2.0 mandate requires all new software to use Post-Quantum Cryptography by 2030.

ciso_nurture.subject: The cost of delaying PQC migration (Case Studies) 📉
ciso_nurture.headline: Why Migrate Now?
ciso_nurture.body_html:
Migrating to PQC is not a flip of a switch. It requires discovering all cryptographic assets, testing hybrid TLS handshakes, and updating PKI.

Read our latest case studies on how enterprise teams are using QuantCAI to map their cryptographic inventory and automate the transition to ML-KEM.

ciso_nurture.subject: Schedule a PQC Readiness Workshop with QuantCAI 📅
ciso_nurture.headline: Let's Build Your Migration Plan
ciso_nurture.body_html:
We offer hands-on workshops for enterprise security teams to build a concrete timeline for PQC migration.

In this 60-minute session, we'll review your audit report and map out a step-by-step transition strategy to meet CNSA 2.0 requirements.

inactive_winback.subject: We miss you at QuantCAI! See what's new 🚀
inactive_winback.headline: New Quantum Features Released
inactive_winback.body_html:
It's been a while since you last simulated a circuit! We've recently added new tools, including a Quantum Phase Estimation visualizer and an updated Qiskit export engine.

Jump back in and continue exploring quantum computing.
